items.text: Check out of APA with day bags only (suitcases already sent to HOTEL TAVINOS).
Ginza Line Tawaramachi → Kanda, JR Yamanote/Chūō Line → Tokyo. Or taxi (~20 min, ~¥3,000).
Nozomi 111 Tokyo → Himeji, Green Car 10, seats 13-C and 13-D (Fuji on the right after ~40 min). Breakfast: ekiben from Tokyo Station.
Arrive Himeji. Coin lockers for the day bags (sizes not verified), north exit.
Ōtemae-dōri straight north to the castle, Sakuramon Bridge, Otemon Gate.
Meet 9:50 in front of Otemon Gate, guide with a 'Himeji Tourism Concierge' sign. Tour 10:00–12:30, tickets included. Socks; shoes off inside.
Walk west along the moat to Kōko-en.
Kōko-en garden (not in the tour): ¥400 each, last entry 16:30. Nine walled gardens with the keep behind.
Lunch near Himeji Station, chosen on the spot: Himeji oden (ginger soy) or anago rice.
Shinkansen Himeji → Kyoto (book on smartEX by Fri 13). Backup: JR Special Rapid, ~1.5 h, ¥2,210, no booking.
Kyoto Stn Hachijō or Karasuma exit → Sanjūsangen-dō. Or city bus 100/206/208 to Hakubutsukan Sanjūsangendō-mae.
Open 8:30–17:00 on Sat 14 (last entry 16:30). Shoes off, no photos inside. 📿 stamp at the exit.
Walk north-west to HOTEL TAVINOS (Kawaramachi Gojō).
Self check-in at HOTEL TAVINOS (machines from 15:00; check-in number A26103018851 + passports). Suitcases should be waiting.
Free time ~2–3 h. Dinner near the hotel, chosen on the spot, or an optional dinner below.
Wagyu sukiyaki, last entry 19:30, ~20 min walk. Needs a reservation.
